text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Osaka Hai,
Maruzensky dedicated herself to her daily training.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Air this cold feels the best!
It really cools down a heated body!
choice_data_list: You seem to be in good shape.
You seem to be in good shape, huh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the race is drawing near, so I guess you could say the voltage is ramping up.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Just thinking about who I'll be running against next gets me so excited and pumped up~."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Besides, look over there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan, that's amazing!
You broke your record yet again!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems the results of your training
are clearly showing, which is wonderful~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Measure mine next!
All right, time to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Those girls who looked up to me as their idol
are giving it their absolute all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Since I've gotten them so hyped up,
I've gotta respond with my race!"
choice_data_list: I'll show you the back you admire, even in the race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, abso-lutely!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go for one more lap!
Time to do the Ganba-rumba~!
Even after training, Maruzensky kept watching her juniors practice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Everyone's working so hard~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To see those cute juniors grow up so much...
it really fills my heart with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is not an easy feat for Umamusume to keep running toward their respective dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, if the ideal figure you strive for is right before your eyes,
you can chase after their back and keep running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky, it seems you have become
a fine guide for your juniors.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, high praise indeed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I have always strived to become that ideal figure—one whom everyone yearns to chase after.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Though honestly, that's just because I want to have fun running with everyone~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Aiming for an ideal form in order to run for fun... huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have continued running for my grand ambition:
to guide all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for some reason, when it comes to you,
I find myself wanting to run for a different reason.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Another reason? What could that be?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Utterly simple—and yet, the very essence of those who run...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Between the current you and me, I wonder
which of us will surge ahead."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my!? Now you've really piqued my curiosity!
I'm getting my hopes up, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, me too.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, so sowwy for inviting you
out of the blue!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, sorry for inviting you
out of the blue like that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, right now, I heard "Italian grub" is all the rage
with the hip youth, so I was thinking of grabbing some—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, what's going on?
So many people are coming this way..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san! A word about the showdown at the Osaka Hai, please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: How confident are you feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wh-What, what...?! Swarming me all at once isn't going to help me understand?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
We've received intel that
Symboli Rudolf will be running in the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Did you know about this, Trainer-kun!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Did you know about this, Trainer-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: The media's in a total frenzy! How are you feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look at how hyped up all the reporters are!
There's no way the one actually running wouldn't be fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! Sorry to spring this on you again,
but rather than Italian food...
choice_data_list: Time to train for the showdown!
Time to train for the showdown!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! Sorry to spring this on you
out of nowhere again, but instead of Italian food...
choice_data_list: Time to train for the showdown!
Time to train for the showdown!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll make this the greatest race ever!

The showdown with the "Emperor", Symboli Rudolf,
at the Osaka Hai is finally going to happen...!
